query: SELECT token_id, name, token_nbf, token_exp, allowed_ips, created, COUNT(*) OVER() AS "total_count!" FROM user_api_token WHERE user_id = $1 AND revoked IS NULL AND ($2::TEXT IS NULL OR name ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%') AND ($3::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL OR token_nbf >= $3) AND ($4::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL OR token_nbf <= $4) AND ($5::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL OR token_exp >= $5) AND ($6::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL OR token_exp <= $6) AND ($7::INET IS NULL OR $7::INET <<= ANY(allowed_ips)) AND ($8::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL OR created >= $8) AND ($9::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL OR created <= $9) ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT $10 OFFSET $11;
